newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Three Russia borderguards in drunken killing spree.
newsitem.headline: Three Russia borderguards in drunken killing spree.

text.p: Three Russian border guards went on a drunken rampage with assault rifles and a machinegun on Thursday, killing two officers and taking hostages before two of the soldiers committed suicide.

Police said the three conscripts had returned drunk to their post in the Russian Far East after being absent without leave. When asked by warrant officers where they had been, they sprayed them with bullets from their assault rifles.
One officer died immediately and the other later in hospital.
The soldiers then took a doctor and an ambulance driver hostage and tried to escape in an ambulance and a mini-bus but were surrounded by local police.
During a final shoot-out, two border guards were wounded and two of the hostage takers shot themselves dead. The third soldier surrendered to police. The two hostages were unhurt.
Cases of soldiers shooting their comrades or superiors have become quite common in recent years as low morale and chronic cash shortages take their toll on Russia's once proud armed forces.

Last Sunday two students of a military college near the city of Volgograd shot dead five fellow cadets and an instructor before fleeing with submachineguns and ammunition. The two 18-year-olds were later captured in a big police and military operation.
